hulls.name: AKKORD
hulls.status: KEGM, 7 Sep: not yet south, no movement filed. Still frozen on 4 Sep, at 22 days the longest freeze here.

hulls.name: STRATEG
hulls.status: Already south, on its own AIS: a second live track on the same MMSI enters the Marmara 31 Aug 09:48 UTC, waits off the Dardanelles 1-2 Sep and is in the Aegean 3 Sep. Not in any straits queue (both legs cleared).

hulls.name: PIROP
hulls.status: KEGM, 7 Sep: still in the Black Sea, no movement filed. Still frozen on 4 Sep.

hulls.name: KHRIZOPRAZ
hulls.status: KEGM, 7 Sep: in the Bosporus southbound queue, SP1 filed 6 Sep, SP2 7 Sep. Its transmitter was still frozen on 4 Sep, the last AIS day here.

hulls.name: DEMANTOID
hulls.status: KEGM, 7 Sep: crossed the Bosporus southbound 6 Sep (sighted); in the Dardanelles southbound queue, ready since 6 Sep 18:39.

hulls.name: MIMOZA
hulls.status: Already south, on its own AIS: a second live track on the same MMSI starts 28 Aug 09:06 UTC inside the Bosporus and reaches Port Said by 3 Sep, while the frozen one sat at the entrance until 31 Aug. Not in any straits queue.

hulls.name: LABRADOR
hulls.status: KEGM, 7 Sep: not yet south — only its northbound leg is listed (in the strait 1 Sep 08:00). Still frozen on 4 Sep.

hulls.name: INVICTA
hulls.status: Added 2026-09-08 with the widened approach box: froze 2-3 Sep at 41.2809 N, 29.0366 E, ~30 km south of the other seven at the mouth of the strait. It is the one hull here that did NOT move onto a Russian 273* MMSI - it went Cameroon 613510201 -> Guinea-Bissau 631010125 on 5 Jul and kept its name. No Sentinel-2 sighting during its two frozen days, by the GNN or by the embedding hunt, so its freeze is not independently corroborated.
